translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Dos Kodpiyod ki Disas diyot ki Pilato
To od ka-allow ron, id pomuhawang iddos langun no ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio ko momonnu ran od ko-imotayan si Disas.
Id baku ran iddos bollad din woy id piyod dan sikandin diyot ki Pilato no gubernador to Roma.
Dos Kodpongoggot ni Judas

Na si Judas no id boligya ki Disas, to nokita rin no id silutan si Disas to kopotayan, nokodsondit sikandin taddot id puungan din, woy id po-uli rin iddos otollumpuun plata no soopi riyot mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy'd pombuyyahon to mgo Judio.
Kahi rin kandan to, “Nokosaa a, su id boligya ku iddos minuvu no waa saa.” Mid tavak sikandan to, “Te! Ondan mak lavut doy? Sikkow ron man kos bahala tadda!”
Na, id sovuwak ni Judas iddos soopi riyot osag to templo. Mid awa sikandin woy id pongoggot ukit to kodbovitin.

Na, id pomurut taddot mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis iddos soopi woy kahi ran to, “Id diiyan diyot keton mgo Suhu no id timuu ini riyot tootawwan to soopi to templo, oyya su nahamit man ini atag to kodbayad to kod-imatoy to minuvu.”
De-en id pomuhawang dan nod gomiton iddon soopi to kodbolli to livuta riyot minuvu no tohodbovaa to kuron amoy od lovongngan atag to mgo moholiyug nod patoy.
Purisu taman ko-ungkay, id ngoranan don iddon livuta to ‘Livuta nid Boyaran to Longossa.’
Ukit tadda, notuman iddos id ikahi dangan ni propeta Jeremias no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Id angoy ran iddos otollumpuun plata no soopi, no idda en no kontidad kos no-unduhan to dumon koubbaran ni Israel no id bolli kandin.
Woy id gamit idda amoy id bolli to livuta riyot minuvu no tohodbovaa to kuron iling taddot id suhu koddi to Monama.”

content: Si Disas diyot Isowwan ni Pilato
Na si Disas, mid lohinat diyot isowwan to gubernador woy id intud kandin iddos gubernador, kahi rin to, “Sikkow vo kos hari to mgo Judio?” Mid tavak si Disas to, “No-oseng dud en.”
Piru waa tovaka ni Disas iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio no id uug kandin no nokopuung sikandin to saa.
Na mid ikahi si Pilato to, “Waa ru vo norinog iddos mo-uraan saa no id uug dan kikow?”
Piru waa en id tavak si Disas ahad sokkad taddot saa nid uug dan kandin, de-en oray'n nosoobbuwan dos gubernador.
Dos Kodsilut ki Disas to Kopotayan
Na ipat pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan, nooyami ron to gubernador nod poleggua to sokkad no pinirisu no od buyuwon to mo-uraan minuvu.
Iddon timpu, duwon pinirisu no novantug nod puung to morat no id ngoranan ki Barabas.
De-en to nolivuung don iddos mo-uraan minuvu, id intud si Pilato kandan, kahi rin to, “Ondoy man kos id kopi-i row nod polegguangon ku, si Barabas bo o si Disas no id ngoranan no Mesiyas?”
Id oseng ni Pilato idda, su nosorollan din no kosina kos unayan no id boggoy ran si Disas diyot bollad din.

Laggun to id unsad pa si Pilato diyot unsaran to kodhukum, duwon id inguma no id piyod to sulat pomon diyot sawa ni Pilato. Woy nokosulat dutun no, “Yo ru monnuwa kos minuvu no waa saa, su genot bulli duwon morat no tohenoppon ku moka-atag kandin woy noosayan a oraroy taddon tohenoppon.”
Piru id sutsutan taddot mgo tohodbuwis woy'd pombuyyahon to mgo Judio iddos mgo minuvu, no iyon dan od buyuwon nod polegguangon, si Barabas woy od po-imotayan si Disas.
Na mid intud mandon si Pilato, kahi rin to, “Ondoy musing ka-ay't oruwa kos id kopi-i row nod polegguangon ku?” Mid tavak sikandan to, “Si Barabas!”
Kahi rin mandon to, “Ondan kos od puungan ku ki Disas no id ngoranan no Mesiyas?” Na langun dan mid tavak to, “Id pakpak sikandin diyon to krus!”
Piru mid ikahi si Pilato kandan to, “Mambo? Ondan man kos saa no nopuungan din?” Na, id ayas pe-en id pehes iddos mgo minuvu no mid ungketen to, “Id pakpak en sikandin diyon to krus!”

To nokita ni Pilato no worad en koru-anon taddot osengan din diyot mgo minuvu woy od ko-ukag don nanoy sikandan, id angoy sikandin to oweg woy id ounab to bollad din diyot isowwan to mo-uraan minuvu. Kahi rin to, “Waa en lavut ku to kopotayan ka-ay'n minuvu! Koniyu ron no saa!”
Mid tavak iddos langun no minuvu to, “Oyya! Sikami woy dos mgo anak doy kos od sukutan taddot kandin no kopotayan!”
Na id poleggua ni Pilato si Barabas, piru si Disas, id polompossan din, woy id boggoy rin diyot bollad to mgo sundau amoy id pakpak diyon to krus.
Dos Kodsumpalit to mgo Sundau ki Disas
Na, id piyod to mgo sundau si Disas diyot baoy to gubernador woy nokolingkus kandin iddos langun no duma ran no mgo sundau.
Id lusutan dan si Disas, woy id umpakan dan tod momoollutun umpak iling to umpak to hari.

Id podlambed dan kos duhiyon no baahon, woy id bovallan dan idda no kuruna no id takos diyot uu ni Disas. Nopongnga, id posomad sikandin to bookayu riyot kowanan no bollad din no uvag kun to bastun to hari. Na mid lingko-od dan diyot isowwan din woy id sumpalit dan sikandin, kahi ran to, “Muopa no mowwet kos umuu ru, sikkow no Hari to mgo Judio!”
Na, id pon-ilobban dan sikandin woy id angoy ran iddos id somaddan din no bookayu, woy id pipit dan idda riyot uu rin.
To nopongnga ran mid sumpalit kandin, id lusut dan iddos od momoollutun umpak woy id posukub dan mandon iddos umpak din. Nopongnga, id piyod dan sikandin diyot leggua amoy id pakpak diyon to krus.
Dos Kodpakpak ki Disas diyon to Krus
To id leggua ran don pomon diyot bonuwa, nosinuggung dan iddos minuvu no id ngoranan ki Simon no toho Cirene, woy id pohos dan sikandin nod tiyang taddot krus ni Disas.
Na, id inguma ran don diyot lugaa nod ngoranan to Golgota, (no iddos kohulugan, lugaa to Bongovongo).
Id boggayan dan si Disas to binu no id sombutan to mopet no bawi nod pokotogka to mosakit. Piru to id geddaman din idda, mid elle sikandin nod inom tadda.
Na id pakpak dan si Disas diyon to krus, woy id bunutbunut dan atag taddot ogget ni Disas ko ondan kos od kokomunoy to ipat sokkad kandan.
Nopongnga idda, mid unsad sikandan amoy'd tamong kandin.
Na riyot lomig datas to uu ni Disas, id tawwan dan to korotula, woy nokosulat dutun iddos saa nid uug dan kandin no mid ungketen to, “Ini en si Disas no Hari to mgo Judio.”
Na, duwon oruwon kriminal no id pakpak dan mandad diyon to krus no riyot tapad ibpit ni Disas. Iddos sokkad, diyon lomig to kowanan din woy dos sokkad, diyon lomig to ivang.
Na iddos mgo minuvu nid lihad dutun, id ponlingi-lingi ran woy id sumpalit dan sikandin.

Kahi ran to, “Tomman du, od gobban du iddos templo woy'd poohinaton du mandon daom da to otollun allow. Otik mooggot en iddos id oseng du, tovangiyu kos ko-ugolingun du! Woy otik mooggot ka en no Anak to Monama, ponog ka ruwot krus!”
Mid sumpalit mandad kandin iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis, dos mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises woy dos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio.
Kahi ran to, “Te, id tovangan din kos duma, piru dii man sikandin od pokotavang to ko-ugolingun din! Tomman din no Hari sikandin to Israel. Otid pokoponog sikandin duwot krus, od pomakoy ki kandin.
Id salig man sikandin to Monama woy id ikahi rin pe-en no Anak sikandin to Monama. Na, od ontongngan ta ve-en kod tovangan sikandin to Monama!”
Ahad pe-en iddos mgo kriminal nid pakpak diyon to krus no duug din, iling dad en mandad tadda kos kodsumpalit dan kandin.
Dos Kopotayan ni Disas
Na, to moko-untud don kos allow, tigkow id mosukirom kos intirut ingod daom to otollun uras.
To mgo alas tres don to mapun, id pehes si Disas to monokkaa no mid ungketen to, “Eli, Eli, lema sabactani?” no iddos kohulugan, “Monama ku, Monama ku, mambot id tonanan a nikkow?”
To norinog idda taddot dumon minuvu nod loohinat dutun, mid ikahi sikandan to, “Id umow rin si Elias!”
Sokkad kandan, id lungkossu woy mid angoy to immat bukoo nid aggom diyot suka, woy id takos din idda riyot ubpu to panga to kayu. Nopongnga, id bullow rin idda amoy id po-inom kandin.
Piru mid ikahi iddos duma to, “Podtohona row sikandin. Od ongatan ta woy'd ontongngan ta kod loppow vo si Elias amoy'd tavang kandin.”
Na id pehes mandon si Disas to monokkaa, woy id salig din kos ispiritu rin diyot Monama.
Idda ron en, iddos oray'n mokoppaan kurtina riyon to templo, novendas pomon diyot datas po-undiyot dosiyung. Na, id linug woy nongotobbag dos doorakkoon mgo batu.
Nopokes kos mgo lovongngan woy mo-uraan minuvu to Monama nid poomatoy no nongovadnow.
Id leggua sikandan pomon diyot lovongngan. Woy to novadnow ron si Disas, iddos id poomatoy no nongovadnow, mid undiyot Jerusalem woy mo-uraan minuvu no nokokita kandan.

Na, iddos kopitan to mgo sundau woy dos mgo sakup din no id tamong ki Disas, nokorinog taddon linug woy nokita ran iddos mgo notomanan, woy oraroy ran no novaakkan. Kahi ran to, “Bonnaa vos en no Anak sikandin to Monama!”
Na, duwon mo-uraan ba-ay rutun no id pomantow riyot moriyu boyow. Sikandan iddos id dumoruma ki Disas pomon poron diyot Galilea, woy id tovangan dan sikandin.
Dos duma kandan, si Maria no toho Magdala, si Maria no inoy ni Santiago woy Jose woy dos sawa ni Sebedeo.
Dos Kodlobbong ki Disas
To od kosagkup don, id inguma iddos od koruwonnan no minuvu no id ngoranan ki Jose no toho Arimatea. Sokkad sikandin taddot od pondumoruma ki Disas.
Mid undiyon sikandin to ki Pilato amoy od buyuwon din nod ongayon iddos bangkoy ni Disas. Na, id aman si Pilato tadda.
De-en id angoy ni Jose iddon bangkoy, woy id bukusan din to lammi woy mahaa no ogget.
Woy id ta-aw rin idda riyot langub no lovongngan no lammi rin id bongbangan atag to ko-ugolingun din. Na, id lokobban din idda to dakkoon batu woy mid ipanow sikandin.
Iddos mgo ba-ay no si Maria no toho Magdala woy dos sokkad pa no Maria, id unsad dutun nid isau riyot lovongngan.
To so-op no allow no idda en kos Allow't Kod-imolloy, mid undiyot ki Pilato iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos mgo Pariseo.
Kahi ran to, “Sir, nosompottan doy no iddot no-uyag pa iddos bouhuson no minuvu, mid ikahi sikandin no od kovadnow kun sikandin otid lihad kos iko-otollun allow.

De-en iyon ayu moppiya no od suhu ka to minuvu nod potomongngon tat lovongngan din taman to otollun allow, su saddook od undiyon iddos mgo tinodduwan din amoy'd takow taddot bangkoy rin woy'd osengon dan no novadnow ron sikandin. Ko ungketen kos od puungan dan, iddos kod-ouhus dan, od lampas pe-en taddot unna.”
Kahin Pilato kandan to, “Oyya, piyoddow kos mgo sundau woy ooyyari row tod tamong dos lovongngan.”
De-en id ipanow ran, woy id tawwan dan to patow dos batu riyot sobbangan to lovongngan amoy'd kosorollan ko duwon od lukat tadda. Nopongnga, id tuwos dan iddos mgo sundau amoy'd tamong tadda.

footnotes.text: Od kovasa ini riyot Zacarias 11:12-13; Jeremias 32:6-9.
